recommendedNewSections.heading: How to Choose the Best AI Website Builder for Your Needs
recommendedNewSections.reason: Directly addresses the core user intent ('best AI website builder') and helps users navigate the many options. Competitors list builders but don't always provide a comprehensive guide on how to choose.
recommendedNewSections.suggestedOutline: Define your project goals (e-commerce, portfolio, blog, business site); Consider your budget (free vs. paid features); Evaluate ease of use and customization options; Look for specific features (SEO, integrations, e-commerce tools); Check for scalability and support.

recommendedNewSections.heading: Key Features to Look for in an AI Website Builder
recommendedNewSections.reason: While some competitors mention features, a dedicated H2 to elaborate on essential features (AI capabilities, design flexibility, SEO tools, integrations, hosting) would be highly valuable and help users understand what makes a builder 'best'.
recommendedNewSections.suggestedOutline: AI Design & Content Generation; Customization & Template Options; SEO & Marketing Tools; E-commerce Functionality; Hosting & Domain Management; Integrations & Third-Party Apps.

recommendedNewSections.heading: Pros and Cons of Using AI Website Builders
recommendedNewSections.reason: Competitor 5 has H3s for benefits/limitations, and Rank 3 has a FAQ on 'Why should I build with AI?'. A dedicated H2 section would provide a balanced view, helping users make an informed decision.
recommendedNewSections.suggestedOutline: Pros: Speed, Ease of Use, Cost-Effectiveness, Design Assistance; Cons: Limited Customization, AI Hallucinations/Errors, Dependence on Platform, Learning Curve.

recommendedNewSections.heading: AI Website Builders for Specific Use Cases
recommendedNewSections.reason: Users often look for solutions tailored to their specific needs (e.g., 'best for small business,' 'best for e-commerce'). This section would categorize builders or features by common use cases.
recommendedNewSections.suggestedOutline: For Small Businesses & Startups; For E-commerce Stores; For Portfolios & Creative Professionals; For Blogs & Content Creators; For Personal Websites.

recommendedNewSections.heading: Pricing Models: Free vs. Paid AI Website Builders
recommendedNewSections.reason: Competitor 1 focuses on 'free' and Rank 3 has a FAQ on 'free'. A dedicated section to discuss different pricing tiers, what's included in free plans, and when to upgrade would be very useful.
recommendedNewSections.suggestedOutline: Understanding Free Plans (limitations, ads, subdomains); Paid Subscription Tiers (basic, premium, business); Hidden Costs & Upsells; Value for Money: When to Invest.
